svg.title: Three processed EMG channel waveforms during representative Session 4 cues
svg.desc: Three stacked time-series panels show one typical 1.5 second cue for REST tilt control and each of DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, TOP. A median log-RMS cue was selected for each class. The 250 millisecond gaps between cue snippets are artificial.
svg.text: Three-channel EMG during representative gesture cues
Session 4 processed filter output; one median-RMS example per label
Cues are approximately 1.5 s; 250 ms display gaps are inserted between excerpts
Separate cue excerpts; the shaded intervals are not one continuous recording timeline
